shouldFix.title: The row-verification instruction compares one cell to the entire serialized row
shouldFix.subjectClaim: Re-read the live DR-117 row by ID; if the fifth cell differs from rowVerbatim, that is a finding against this artifact.
shouldFix.refutation: The unique live DR-117 Markdown row has seven cells. Its fifth cell is exactly 'Explicit successor to P-1/P-2/G3 with enforcement evidence', while /registerRowQuoted/rowVerbatim is the complete pipe-delimited seven-cell row. Those values necessarily differ even though the complete live row is byte-for-text exact to rowVerbatim. The stated comparison therefore fires a false finding on the artifact's own correctly carried row.
shouldFix.impact: This does not expand authority or close DR-117, so it is not a blocker. It does make the artifact's explicit independent-review recipe self-contradictory: a literal reviewer cannot pass the row-custody check when the row is correct, and a non-literal reviewer must silently replace the stated comparison.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Replace 'the fifth cell' with 'the live row', or add a separately named expected-fifth-cell value and compare the fifth cell only to that value. Keep the full-row exact-equality check against rowVerbatim.
